description: Break out of "I don't know what I want it to look like, but I'll know it when I see it" by generating a rendered batch of visibly different design options along explicit axes (color intensity, layout/organization strategy, or others the request names), grounded in existing design tokens/brand colors/screenshots, self-reviewed before showing, then implemented from the picked option's principles (color roles, density, hierarchy) rather than copying its pixels or markup. Use when the user can't put a visual style into words, says "I'll know it when I see it," asks for design options/variants/directions/mockups to react to, wants to compare looks before committing, is stuck between vague descriptors like "modern but not too corporate," or asks to redesign/restyle a screen, component, dashboard, or page with no clear spec. Also use once the user has pointed at a variant and wants it built for real.

results.query: I can't describe the style I want — just generate a bunch of visual options for me to react to.
Show me several different visual directions for this dashboard so I can pick the one closest to what I want.
This design feels too colorful — give me some toned-down alternatives to compare.
I rejected the last three mockups as too generic — batch-generate more options with clearer contrast between them.
Evolve our existing design system without throwing away the current components — show me a few visual directions.
Give me a color-intensity ladder for this UI, from muted to bold, so I can pick a level.
I want to see multiple visual style options for this landing page before committing to one.
Batch-generate some UI style variations based on these reference screenshots I like.
Extract the design system (colors, typography, spacing) from these screenshots into documentation.
Audit this already-built page for visual bugs like overlap and overflow.
Build a working React component from this design spec.
Generate a single polished hero image for our marketing page, I already know exactly what I want.
Write the CSS to implement this exact Figma design, pixel for pixel.
Create a full QA test plan for this application's UI.
Explain the difference between CSS Grid and Flexbox with code examples.
Write the backend API for saving a user's theme preference.
